dialogue.origin: （本日は宜しくお願いします。時間になったら始めさせていただきます。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for coming today. We will begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.origin: (よろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.content: (Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんは初めに年齢、性別、今日お話ししたい事を教えてください
dialogue.content: Good evening. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: こんばんは70歳男、兄が老後の資金を使い込んでいました
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm a 70-year-old man, and my older brother has squandered our retirement funds.

dialogue.origin: それはショックなことがあったのですねお兄さまは一緒に暮らしていらっしゃるのでしょうか
dialogue.content: That must have been a shock. Does your older brother live with you?

dialogue.origin: いえ、別に暮らしています
dialogue.content: No, we live separately.

dialogue.origin: どういった状況だったのかもう少し教えていただけますか
dialogue.content: Could you tell me a little more about the situation?

dialogue.origin: はい、兄弟に障害者手帳を持ってる者がおりまして、老後を心配した母が資金を貯めておりました。母の死後、兄がそれを巻き上げて使い込んでしまったのです
dialogue.content: Yes, one of my siblings has a disability certificate, and our mother, worried about their old age, had saved up some money. After our mother passed away, my older brother took it all and spent it.

dialogue.origin: そんなことがあったんですねとても腹立たしい思いをされたのではないでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what happened. You must have felt incredibly frustrated and angry.

dialogue.origin: ほんとに、うんざりします
dialogue.content: I really am. It's exasperating.

dialogue.origin: お辛い状況だと思いますご兄弟は3人でしょうか
dialogue.content: I imagine it's a difficult situation. Are there three siblings in total?

dialogue.origin: 4人です
dialogue.content: There are four of us.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただいてありがとうございます。他にご家族はいらっしゃいますか
dialogue.content: Thank you for telling me. Do you have any other family?

dialogue.origin: 私と妹にはそれぞれ家族がありますが、あとは独り者です
dialogue.content: My younger sister and I each have our own families, but the others are single.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。このことについて、お金を使い込んでしまったお兄さまとなにかお話されましたか
dialogue.content: Thank you. Have you spoken with your older brother about him spending the money?

dialogue.origin: 何考えてんだとか、使ってしまってどうすんだとか、責めることは言いました
dialogue.content: I said some blaming things, like, "What were you thinking?" and "What are we supposed to do now that you've spent it all?"

dialogue.origin: きっぱりと抗議されたんですねご兄弟の大切な今後の生活資金を使われてしまって怒りや悲しいお気持ちでいっぱいだったのではないかと思います
dialogue.content: So you confronted him directly. I imagine you must have been filled with anger and sadness, seeing your sibling's important future living funds being used up like that.

dialogue.origin: お兄さまは何か返されましたか
dialogue.content: Did your older brother say anything in response?

dialogue.origin: 泣きそうになって黙っていました
dialogue.content: He looked like he was about to cry and just stayed silent.

dialogue.origin: 泣きそうに、、そうでしたか何か事情があったのようでしょうか
dialogue.content: About to cry... I see. Do you think there might have been a reason for it?

dialogue.origin: いや、特にないんじゃないかと思ってます独身貴族で、今までたくさん後輩に奢ってきたプライドみたいのが、定年後も抜けなかったんじゃないかと
dialogue.content: No, I don't think there was any particular reason. He's a well-off bachelor, and I think he couldn't let go of the pride he got from treating his juniors all the time, even after retirement.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、気前の良い方と周囲に思われていたのですねそれが理由だとなかなか許しにくいお気持ちではないかと思ったのですがいかがですか
dialogue.content: I see... so he was known by others as a generous person. If that's the reason, I would think it makes it quite difficult for you to forgive him. How do you feel about that?

dialogue.origin: そうですね気前がよくなかったとしても、良い兄貴だったのに、ほんとに腹が立ちます
dialogue.content: That's right. Even if he wasn't generous, he was a good older brother. I'm just so angry.

dialogue.origin: いい思い出がおありなんですね
dialogue.content: You have good memories of him, don't you?

dialogue.origin: そうですね兄弟の面倒をよくみてくれる兄でした
dialogue.content: Yes, he was the kind of brother who always looked after his siblings.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですねご兄弟から慕われていたんですね今回の事は信じられないようなことだったですね
dialogue.content: I see. So he was well-loved by his siblings. This must have been unbelievable for you.

dialogue.origin: 他のご兄弟とはこのことで何かお話されましたか
dialogue.content: Have you spoken with your other siblings about this?

dialogue.origin: 妹には話しました
dialogue.content: I spoke with my younger sister.

dialogue.origin: 妹さんはなにかおっしゃっていましたか
dialogue.content: Did your sister say anything?

dialogue.origin: もう兄の面倒はみなくていい、といっていました
dialogue.content: She said we don't need to look after our older brother anymore.

dialogue.origin: お兄さまの面倒をみられていたのですか
dialogue.content: Have you been looking after your older brother?

dialogue.origin: そうです昨年脳梗塞で倒れて、病院や自宅の引き払いを手伝いました使い込みも、その時にわかりました
dialogue.content: Yes. He had a stroke last year, and I helped with the hospital and with clearing out his home. That's when I found out about the squandering.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたかご兄弟で助け合っておられたんですね相談者様はお兄さまとの今後についてはどのように思われているんでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see. So you siblings were helping each other out. How do you feel about your future relationship with your older brother?

dialogue.origin: 今は施設に入って、自由に飲みに行ったり、後輩たちと遊んだりできなくなったと思うのですなので、このまま静かにしていてほしいと思います
dialogue.content: He's in a facility now, so I don't think he can go out drinking or hang out with his juniors anymore. So, I just want him to live quietly from now on.

dialogue.origin: とてもお辛い気持ちで面倒を見られるのは嫌な時もあると思います。今後はどうなっていけばいいと思われますか
dialogue.content: It must be unpleasant at times to have to look after him while feeling so hurt. What would you like to see happen in the future?

dialogue.origin: 使い込んだお金は戻らないと思うのです仕事もしてないしなので、自分の年金の範囲で過ごしてもらいたいです
dialogue.content: I don't think the money he spent will ever come back. He's not working either. So, I want him to live within the means of his own pension.

dialogue.origin: そうですね今後の資金のことなどご不安もあるかもしれませんが支援など調べてみてもいいかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: I understand. You may be worried about future funds, but it might be a good idea to look into what kind of support is available.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 身内が使い込んだ場合も、支援が受けられるものでしょうか
dialogue.content: Is it possible to receive support even if a family member has squandered the money?

dialogue.origin: もしも障害手帳をお持ちで金銭的に苦しい状況があれば一度相談にいかれてもいいと思います
dialogue.content: If the sibling with the disability certificate is in a difficult financial situation, I think it would be a good idea to go for a consultation.

dialogue.origin: どこに相談に行ったもですか？
dialogue.content: Where should I go to consult?

dialogue.origin: 市役所で手帳を発行している窓口はどうでしょう
dialogue.content: How about the window at the city hall that issues the certificates?

dialogue.origin: なるほど、障がい福祉課ですね
dialogue.content: I see, the Disability Welfare Section, right?

dialogue.origin: なるべくお一人で抱えず相談してみていただきたいです。
dialogue.content: I hope you'll try to talk with them instead of bearing this all by yourself.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 本日はお時間が来てしまいましたまたいつでもお話しに来てください
dialogue.content: Our time is up for today. Please feel free to come and talk anytime.

dialogue.origin: 終了のメッセージが流れますありがとうございました
dialogue.content: The closing message will now play. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （少しオーバーしてしまいました。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (We went a little over time. Thank you.)

topic.sub: 兄の金銭問題とその影響
